mcat_description.short: Metal Sheds are prefabricated steel or iron structures — comprising MS/GI frames, metal sheet roofing, and optional wall cladding — sold as complete turnkey units or supply-and-erect packages for industrial, agricultural, and storage applications.
mcat_description.long: Metal Sheds in the Indian B2B market are pre-engineered or prefabricated structural enclosures built primarily from mild steel (MS) sections, galvanised iron (GI) sheets, or Galvalume-coated roofing panels, with frames fabricated off-site and assembled on-site. They range from simple open-sided roofing sheds and farm shelters to fully enclosed factory buildings with insulated sandwich panel walls, sliding doors, and PVC windows. The dominant commercial form is the industrial or warehouse-type shed, quoted per square foot of covered area and customised to buyer-specified dimensions, height, and load requirements. Structural steel used in these sheds typically conforms to IS 2062 (hot-rolled structural steel) and IS 15917 (prefabricated building design), with roofing sheets conforming to relevant BIS standards for coated steel.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Metal Sheds' is dominated by prefabricated industrial and warehouse-type steel structures, with 'iron shed' being the most common buyer search term (higher Google impressions than 'metal shed'). The market uses 'PEB shed' (Pre-Engineered Building) as a premium sub-category where structural components are computer-designed using BIM/CAD software and fabricated to precise tolerances, while simpler 'prefab sheds' use standard MS angle/channel sections. Structural steel in these sheds typically conforms to IS 2062 (hot-rolled medium and high tensile structural steel) and prefabricated building design follows IS 15917:2010; roofing sheets are commonly Galvalume-coated or GI-coated conforming to BIS standards. The term 'patra shed' is widely used in Hindi-speaking markets to refer to corrugated metal sheet roofing sheds. Key buyer decision dimensions are covered area (sq ft), clear-span width, eave height, roof sheet type (GI vs Galvalume vs sandwich panel), insulation (glass wool/rock wool), and wind/seismic zone compliance. Manufacturing hubs for metal shed fabricators include Rajkot (Gujarat), Kolhapur (Maharashtra), Ghaziabad (UP), and Kolkata (West Bengal). The PEB market in India is projected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 11.5% between 2025–2030, driven by industrialisation and logistics expansion (single source — low confidence). Buyers range from SME factory owners and warehouse operators to agricultural farm owners and residential buyers adding rooftop enclosures.
